# Apple Podcasts Show & Episode Keyword Search Scraper

Search and discover shows and episodes on Apple's public podcast directory. Search podcasts or episodes by keyword, browse trending/top-chart shows by category and country, or pull the full episode list for specific podcast URLs. No API key or registration required.

## What this actor does

- **Four modes:** `searchPodcasts`, `searchEpisodes`, `trending` (top-chart shows), and `podcastDetails` (full episode list for given podcast URLs)
- **16 category filters** — True Crime, Comedy, News, Technology, Business, and more, usable across every mode
- **22 country stores** — filter podcasts and charts by country/language, from the US to Japan to Brazil
- **Direct audio links** — every episode record includes the direct MP3/M4A file URL
- **Empty fields are omitted** — a record only carries the attributes the source actually returned

## Output per podcast / episode

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `podcastId` | Apple Podcasts ID |
| `title` | Podcast title |
| `author` | Publisher / author name |
| `authorUrl` | Author's Apple Podcasts page, when available |
| `url` | Apple Podcasts URL |
| `sourceUrl` | Source URL |
| `feedUrl` | RSS feed URL |
| `imageUrl` | Cover artwork (600x600) |
| `episodeCount` | Total number of episodes |
| `latestEpisodeDate` | Date of most recent episode |
| `isExplicit` | Whether the podcast is marked explicit |
| `primaryGenre` | Primary genre (e.g., True Crime) |
| `categories` | All genre categories (array) |
| `language` | Language of the podcast |
| `country` | Country store |
| `contentRating` | Content rating (Clean, Explicit) |
| `recordType` | Always `"podcast"` |
| `scrapedAt` | UTC timestamp |

### Episode Records

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `episodeId` | Apple episode ID |
| `episodeTitle` | Episode title |
| `podcastTitle` | Parent podcast title |
| `podcastId` | Parent podcast ID |
| `podcastUrl` | Parent podcast Apple Podcasts URL |
| `episodeUrl` | Episode page URL |
| `sourceUrl` | Source URL |
| `audioUrl` | Direct audio file URL (MP3) |
| `imageUrl` | Episode artwork |
| `description` | Episode description |
| `publishDate` | Publish date (ISO 8601) |
| `durationMinutes` | Duration in minutes |
| `isExplicit` | Explicit content flag |
| `episodeGuid` | Unique episode GUID |
| `categories` | Genre categories |
| `fileExtension` | Audio file format (e.g. `"mp3"`, `"m4a"`) |
| `contentType` | Episode content type: `"audio"` or `"video"` |
| `recordType` | Always `"episode"` |
| `scrapedAt` | UTC timestamp |

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `searchPodcasts` | `searchPodcasts` / `searchEpisodes` / `trending` / `podcastDetails` |
| `searchQuery` | string | – | Search term (modes `searchPodcasts`, `searchEpisodes`) |
| `category` | string | – (all) | One of 16 category filters, e.g. `True Crime`, `Technology` |
| `language` | string | `us` | Country store, e.g. `us`, `gb`, `de`, `jp` |
| `podcastUrls` | array | `[]` | Podcast URLs to fetch episode lists for (mode `podcastDetails`) |
| `maxItems` | int | `50` | Hard cap on emitted records (1–500) |

### Example: search podcasts in a category

```json
{
  "mode": "searchPodcasts",
  "searchQuery": "true crime",
  "category": "1488",
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: trending shows in Germany

```json
{
  "mode": "trending",
  "language": "de",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: episode list for a specific podcast

```json
{
  "mode": "podcastDetails",
  "podcastUrls": ["https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/crime-junkie/id1322200189"],
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

## Use cases

- **Podcast discovery tools** — power a recommendation engine or directory search box
- **Trend tracking** — monitor which shows are climbing the charts by category and country
- **Content aggregation** — gather podcast and episode metadata for a database
- **Audio pipelines** — collect direct episode audio URLs for downstream processing
- **Market research** — compare category and country coverage for podcast advertising

## FAQ

**Do I need an API key?**
No. This actor reads Apple Podcasts' own free public directory and chart data — no keys, no registration.

**How many results can I get?**
Up to 500 records per run with `maxItems`. `trending` is capped at the chart's own top-100 positions.

**Which countries are supported?**
22 country stores: US, GB, DE, FR, ES, PT, JP, KR, CN, IT, NL, SE, DK, FI, NO, PL, RU, BR, MX, IN, AU, CA.

**Can I get episodes for a specific podcast?**
Yes — use `mode=podcastDetails` with podcast URLs like `https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/crime-junkie/id1322200189`.

**Does this return audio URLs?**
Yes — episode records include `audioUrl` with the direct audio file link.

**Can I find non-English podcasts?**
Yes — set `language` to a non-US country code (e.g. `de` for German, `jp` for Japanese) to get podcasts from that store.

**Is this affiliated with Apple Podcasts?**
No. This is an independent third-party actor that reads Apple Podcasts' own free public directory data; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.
